basic_details.job_title: District Government Music School Erode Teacher Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The District Government Music School, Erode has invited artists of Erode district only to work as part-time teachers on contract at Rs.7,000/- consolidated pay in four folk art classes: Silambattam, Kummi / Kolattam (Valli), Thappattam and Folk Dance. Applicants must have completed 50 years of age or have 25 years' experience in the relevant art training. Applications may be handed in or posted to the Head Teacher by the evening of 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare an application with your own details (bio-data).
Attach copies of the certificates that prove your work experience.
Hand it in or send it by post to the Head Teacher, District Government Music School, Bhavani Road, Erode - 638 005, by the evening of 30-11-2026.
Produce the original certificates at the interview.
The notice gives the telephone numbers 7373337966 and 04242294365 for contact.

content_sections.heading: About District Government Music School Erode
content_sections.text: The District Government Music School is located at Bhavani Road, Erode. The school conducts part-time folk art training classes, and the notice invites teachers for the classes in Silambattam, Kummi / Kolattam (Valli), Thappattam and Folk Dance. The notice is a press note issued under the Erode District Collector.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only artists belonging to Erode district may apply. The notice names these areas: Erode, Perundurai, Bhavani, Gobichettipalayam, Sathyamangalam, Anthiyur, Modakurichi, Kodumudi, Nambiyur and Thalavadi. The notice does not print an educational qualification or an age cut-off date. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility for each class.

rows.requirement: The applicant must have completed 50 years of age, OR must have 25 years' experience in the relevant art training field
Must have completed 50 years of age

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The posts are filled on a contract basis at Rs.7,000/- consolidated pay. Appointment will be made following the applicable appointment rules. Class timing is Friday and Saturday evening, 4 PM to 6 PM, two hours only.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Government Music School Erode Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare an application with your own details (bio-data). Attach copies of the certificates that prove your work experience. Hand it in or send it by post to the Head Teacher, District Government Music School, Bhavani Road, Erode - 638 005, by the evening of 30-11-2026. Produce the original certificates at the interview. The notice gives the telephone numbers 7373337966 and 04242294365 for contact.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview for these posts, where original certificates must be produced. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Erode Music School teacher posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be handed in or posted by the evening of 30-11-2026.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are open at the District Government Music School, Erode?
faq.answer: Part-time teachers for folk art training classes in Silambattam, Kummi / Kolattam (Valli), Thappattam and Folk Dance.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply?
faq.answer: Only artists belonging to Erode district can apply, from the areas named in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay for these teacher posts?

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?

faq.question: Q8. What are the class timings?

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must I bring to the interview?
